article.story: UCF (3-2) at No. 18 Oklahoma State (3-1), Oct. 10 at 12 p.m. EDT. Opening Line: Oklahoma State by 10.5. Against the spread: Oklahoma State 3-1, UCF 4-1. How to watch: ESPN2 Key stats Oklahoma State Offense Overall: 548.3 yards per game (2nd in FBS) Passing: 327 yards per game (7th) Rushing: 221.3 yards per game (22nd) Scoring: 37.3 points per game (29th) Oklahoma State Defense Overall: 317.3 yards per game (45th in FBS) Passing: 158.5 yards per game (15th) Rushing: 158.8 yards per game (94th) Scoring: 19.8 points per game (44th) UCF Offense Overall: 350.8 yards per game (101st in FBS) Passing: 178.2 yards per game (116th) Rushing: 172.6 yards per game (56th) Scoring: 32.4 points per game (60th) UCF Defense Overall: 343.4 yards per game (62nd in FBS) Passing: 223.4 yards per game (88th) Rushing: 120 yards per game (46th) Scoring: 17.6 points per game (32nd) Oklahoma State is 121st in third down percentage, converting 32% of the time. UCF ranks 74th on defense, holding its opponents to 37.8%. Oklahoma State is 114th in the FBS with a -4 turnover margin, compared to UCF's 14th-ranked +5 margin. Oklahoma State is 91st in FBS in red zone offense, scoring on 83.3% of trips. UCF's red zone defense ranks 41st at 77.8%. UCF is 130th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 26:28, compared to Oklahoma State's 23rd-ranked average of 33:01. Team leaders Oklahoma State Passing: Drew Mestemaker, 1,271 yards, 11 TDs, 5 INTs, 67.4 completion percentage Rushing: Caleb Hawkins, 441 yards on 83 carries, 2 TDs Receiving: Wyatt Young, 410 yards on 22 catches, 3 TDs UCF Passing: Keyone Jenkins, 541 yards, 4 TDs, 2 INTs, 69.7 completion percentage Rushing: Duke Watson, 404 yards on 49 carries, 3 TDs Receiving: Josh Derry, 220 yards on 17 catches, 1 TD Last game Oklahoma State won 41-24 over West Virginia on Sept. 26. Mestemaker passed for 389 yards on 20-of-27 attempts (74.1%) with three touchdowns and one interception. Hawkins carried the ball 31 times for 180 yards and scored one touchdown. Young had eight receptions for 192 yards and one touchdown. UCF was beaten by Houston 27-17 on Oct. 3. Jenkins passed for 253 yards on 23-of-35 attempts (65.7%) with one touchdown and one interception. He also carried the ball five times for -4 yards and one rushing touchdown. Watson had 50 rushing yards on nine carries, adding one reception for -1 yards. Derry had seven receptions for 101 yards and one touchdown. Next game Oklahoma State plays at No. 22 Houston on Oct. 17. UCF hosts No. 8 BYU on Oct. 24.
